# Welcome {.unnumbered .unlisted}


This is the online version of **R for Biostatistics: A
One-Week Boot Camp** by The rgtlab Curriculum Project. We
designed it as a short preparatory course for incoming
graduate students in biostatistics and adjacent programs.

The book covers what an entering masters-level
biostatistician needs in order to be functional in R on
day one of the academic program: installation, basic
syntax, data manipulation with the tidyverse,
visualization with ggplot2, simple statistics, and the
minimum viable reproducibility setup. We designed it for
**five consecutive days** of work, one hour of lecture
content each day and two hours of homework, with no
examinations.

The boot camp is the entry point to a five-volume graduate
sequence:

- **R for Biostatistics: A One-Week Boot Camp** (this
  volume), pre-program preparation.
- [*Biostatistics Practicum*](https://rgtlab.org/practicum)
, workflow infrastructure (Git, Docker, renv, Quarto,
  CDISC).
- [*Statistical Computing in the Age of AI*](https://scai.rgtlab.org)
, introductory methods (linear models, GLM, mixed
  models, survival, Bayesian, bootstrap, simulation).
- [*Advanced Statistical Computing in the Age of AI*](https://scai-advanced.rgtlab.org)
, advanced computing (numerical stability, MCMC, HPC,
  high-dimensional methods, ML, software engineering).
- [*Applied Generative AI for Health Sciences Research*](https://applied-genai.rgtlab.org)
, capability classes, RAG, agents, evaluation,
  regulation, deployment.

See the [Preface](preface.qmd) for the design rationale
and the [Conventions](conventions.qmd) page for visual
cues.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
The [Contents](contents.qmd) page lists every chapter on one page.
:::
